card.name: Linking words in HIV drug text
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, an opening parenthesis, comma, equals sign, of) right before another HIV antiretroviral drug name or abbreviation, in HIV drug labels.

modes.label: Link before a drug name
modes.description: The word with or of just before a named antiretroviral or its abbreviation such as RPV.
modes.example: during postmarketing experience<< with>> RPV-containing regimens.

modes.label: Parenthesis or comma in drug lists
modes.description: An opening parenthesis, comma or equals sign that introduces a generic name or abbreviation after a brand name.
modes.example: the components of ODEFSEY<< (>>FTC, RPV and TAF

card.writes: It likely primes the model to continue with an HIV drug name or abbreviation, though the promoted tokens are not clearly meaningful.
card.plain: It marks the spot in HIV drug labels where another HIV drug name or abbreviation is about to appear.
